description: Enlarging existing window and door openings, replacement windows and doors, new rooflight openings, replacement rooflights in existing openings, rendering the external brickwork, installation of an air source heat pump, air conditioning unit and photovoltaic panels, installation of woodburner flue, and replacement of a brick garden wall with a timber screen.
